name: AUO Corporation
summary: AUO Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of thin film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT-LCDs) and other flat panel displays for various applications. The company operates through two segments, Display and Energy. It also designs, manufactures, and sells ingots, solar wafers, and solar modules, as well as provides technical engineering and maintenance services for solar system projects. The company also sells and leases content management system and related hardware; designs digital signage content and field curation solutions; and designs, manufactures, and sells TFT-LCD modules, backlight modules, and TV sets and related parts.
